updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile

User impact: Users may be unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile.

More info: Affected users may observe missing contacts, blank or grey placeholder entries, or Speed Dial entries that can't be re-added. This behavior may occur across Microsoft Teams desktop and web experiences, Outlook Mobile, and Outlook desktop.
 
More specifically, this issue impacts in-tenant contacts created in Microsoft Teams using the Notify when available presence notification option. Some older contacts may also be impacted under specific circumstances.

Current status: We’ve validated that a problem with a contact-processing component has incorrectly separated some Profile Based Contacts (PBCs) from their associated profiles when specific contact information isn't explicitly stored, causing affected contacts to appear as blank. We’re developing a fix to re-merge the affected contacts with their associated profiles and expect to provide deployment timeline by our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile may be impacted.

Root cause: A problem with a contact-processing component has incorrectly separated some PBCs from their associated profiles when specific contact information isn't explicitly stored, causing affected contacts to appear as blank.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 1:30 PM UTC
